timeline.summary: May 1, 2026: ASKM & Co. issued qualified audit reports on FY26 results citing inadequate Ind AS 36 impairment documentation for ₹587.48 Cr fixed asset impairment.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹6.17 Cr; net loss ₹206.39 Cr (against a loss of ₹43.05 Cr a year earlier).

PRECASTRUCTURES PRIVATE LIMITED, via **Sudheer Rayachoti (Managing Director)**, disclosed holding **50,89,00,968 (90%)** shares of Neueon Corporation Limited under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
The board approved the sale of its Telangana undertaking to Aparna Enterprises Limited.
On October 26, 2026, Neueon Corporation executed a sale deed to sell its immovable property at Sangareddy, Telangana, for ₹90.73 Cr.
On 29‑10‑2026, the Postal Ballot passed the resolutions: approval of Material Related Party Transactions for 2026‑27, raising capital via equity shares, and alteration of Articles of Association.
Neueon Corporation filed Q2FY27 results with revenue of ₹7.25 Cr and a net loss of ₹166.27 Cr due to exceptional items.
